evidence: Whether you're looking for a weekend dance party, a VIP bottle service experience, or a unique space for corporate events and private parties, we deliver the best in LA nightlife.
We are Club Fox, a live music and entertainment venue in California. We host a variety of shows including tribute bands, blues, rock, reggae, and comedy.
Come for the rock 'n' roll vibes, stay for the unforgettable live concerts and themed parties.
We also host parties for all occasions—book your event with us today!
We offer VIP bottle service and host private and corporate events.
Our space features both a lively dining room and private karaoke rooms for a unique dining and entertainment experience.
Our space features a heated patio for private and large group dining, and we welcome reservations for events and special occasions.
The venue offers table reservations for dinner and private events, and hosts a new cabaret experience.
The venue offers a seasonal menu six days a week (closed Tuesdays), baked goods, and catering services for corporate events and weddings.
